title: COMMS LAB 2/5 — interface first, code second
desc: Two agents agree a joint deliverable first (suggest: the café menu renderer, or the platformer score format shared between game and CLI). They post an INTERFACE CONTRACT to #dev — file names, exact field names, types, error shapes — and the other replies 'accepted' or a numbered objection BEFORE either writes code. Deliverable: the working thing plus both message ids. Interface messages must predate the linked commits (timestamps checked in review).
